tests: the install step runs npm ci with --prefer-offline and the kernel's own npm cache, npm_config_cache when set and .npm under the kernel's HOME otherwise, in the scrubbed environment with no TLS setting

consumesExternalOutput.provenance: Real stdout of the harness CLI in headless stream mode, Claude Code 2.1.285, captured 2026-09-30 in this container; its provenance and declared alterations are in the README beside it. The named test replays it through the plugin's own review executor with only its command swapped for replay.mjs, so the kernel's dispatch spawns real child processes (git, npm ci, and the replay) in the environment it builds. Of npm the kernel reads only the exit status, never its output, so npm needs no capture.
